(6) CLEANUP: deleted all TEST_* / test-*-iter43 docs from strategy_imports + strategy_library, restarted backend to flush runtime register_imported cache; GET /api/strategy/registry back to 11 catalog strategies. Known iter39 flake test_backtest_requires_owner was NOT re-run per agent-to-agent note. critical_code_review_comments: server.py L2755 import_backtest_preview: currently pins symbol='BTC/USD' and days=30 as query defaults. For non-crypto imports (e.g. a forex/futures Pine script) BTC/USD may not be representative — consider inferring from draft.market_type[0] or first draft.preferred_coins entry, or expose a symbol picker in the review UI. Not a blocker for iter43 acceptance.

declarative_engine.validate_spec message 'entry must be a non-empty list of conditions' surfaces cleanly through the 422; good UX. However non-compilable drafts still get stored in strategy_imports — consider TTL or explicit reject endpoint to prevent orphan drafts accumulating.
strategy_import.validate_declarative correctly gates on both AI claim AND engine (double-check). Nice defense against LLM hallucinating 'compilable:true' with broken specs.
